facade.global_attribute_policy: closed component attrs plus reviewed global data attributes forwarded to the intended native element
facade.compatibility_delegates: existing SaladUI-only names remain until HUI-H

stylesheet.imported_by: assets/css/app.css into the local application bundle

versioning.wrapper_policy: backward-compatible attrs and slots within a milestone; removals require deprecation and consumer migration evidence
versioning.upstream_diff_review: compare exact Git revision, public component metadata, rendered fixture, and compiled stylesheet digest
versioning.escape_hatch: application-owned primitive only; no direct product import and no authority-bearing attrs
versioning.rollback: revert Section 2.2 and invalidate the changed application asset digest
